issues.description: IAM-policy fetch failure silently produces PASS instead of UNKNOWN/MANUAL
issues.detail: When getIamPolicy raises (e.g., permission denied), the code logs and leaves publicly_shared=False, so the check reports PASS for an image whose sharing state is actually unknown. This is the wrong failure mode for a security tool — an auth error becomes a clean bill of health. Introduce a tri-state or skip the resource rather than defaulting to safe.

issues.description: Image collection is serial while every other resource in this file uses __threading_call__
issues.detail: _get_images iterates project_ids serially and issues one getIamPolicy per image with no concurrency, while sibling collectors in compute_service.py use the existing threaded helper. For projects with many images wall-clock is N * RTT. Match the file's established style and reuse __threading_call__.

issues.description: Naming inconsistency between CheckID, CHANGELOG, PR description, and data field
issues.detail: Directory and class are compute_image_not_publicly_shared, but the PR description references compute_image_publicly_shared, and the check branches on a positive publicly_shared field. The CheckID, directory, class, CHANGELOG, and data field must agree. Pick one canonical name (prefer the positive fact) and align everything.

issues.description: Public-member detection is complected with listing/pagination/error-handling
issues.detail: _get_images interleaves project iteration, pagination, per-image IAM fetch, exception handling, and the allAuthenticatedUsers scan in one nested block. The scan is a pure function from bindings to bool. Extract it as _is_publicly_shared(iam_policy) so the rule can be tested directly without API mocks and the invariant ('true iff some binding grants any role to allAuthenticatedUsers') is documented.

issues.description: Image model discards binding evidence and lacks location/self_link fields
issues.detail: publicly_shared is collapsed to a boolean at construction time, throwing away the role/members that produced it. The model also lacks self_link/region carried by sibling models, making findings hard to act on when names collide across projects. Preserve the offending bindings on the Image value and add the standard locator fields.

issues.description: Image listing lacks an explicit filter or documented invariant for custom-only scope
issues.detail: images().list(project=project_id) is correct for the user's own images, but the description claims 'custom images only' with no filter or comment explaining why project-scoping suffices and whether deprecated images should be excluded. Add a one-line invariant comment or an explicit filter so a future maintainer doesn't 'fix' it by enumerating Google-managed projects.

synthesis.summary: The check works on the happy path but the panel agrees on three substantive concerns. Most consequential: a getIamPolicy exception is silently coerced to publicly_shared=False, turning auth errors into PASS findings — the wrong failure mode for a security tool. The collector is also serial while every other resource in the same file uses __threading_call__, and the naming is inconsistent across CheckID, CHANGELOG, PR description, and the positive data field it branches on. Secondary cleanups: extract the bindings-to-bool rule as a pure function, preserve binding evidence on the Image value, and document the custom-image scope. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK before merge.
